lead: The speaker mentions that catching a frisbee hurts every single time, and they believe that catching it with one hand will cause pain due to the frisbee being made of plastic.

articleBodyHtml:
Frisbee Catching Pain

The speaker mentions that catching a frisbee hurts every single time, and they believe that catching it with one hand will cause pain due to the frisbee being made of plastic.

Frisbee Catching Technique

The speaker struggles to catch frisbees and requires a specific technique, such as clapping or sandwiching the frisbee between two hands.

Rescheduled Collab Stream

The streamer experienced a rescheduled collab stream due to their own incompetence.

Rescheduling Details

The collab stream has been rescheduled to tomorrow.

Upcoming Streaming Schedule

The streamer plans to stream Stellar Blade, an Apex collab with Toasama and RPR, dance, and a collab with Toasama and RPR on Saturday.

New Song Release

The streamer has a new song releasing at the end of the month, which is a collab song with Udara and Kankan.

Tetris Project and Content

The speaker has created a large amount of content and is still engaged with a Tetris-related project.

Tetris Project Milestone

The Tetris project has reached one million views.

Vegetable Soup and Content

The speaker has made a large quantity of vegetable soup, with six servings remaining, and has a freezer stocked with soup rations.

Vegetable Soup Details

The speaker made vegetable soup two days prior and has three servings remaining.

Hot and Sour Soup

The speaker intends to make hot and sour soup and is awaiting a specific ingredient.

Tomato Soup Description

The soup has a hint of tomato and isn't blended tomato soup.

Tomato Soup Clarification

Tomato soup is distinct from soup containing tomato.

Reflection on Past Events

Participants are reflecting on past events, specifically a fortune-telling session by Miou senpai and considering the passage of time (2025).

2026 Year of the Rat

The speaker mentions taking things one step at a time and notes that 2026 is the year of the rat.

Current Location Duration
